operations.summary: SELECT account then UPDATE email preserving SELECTed plan

conflicts.risk_explanation: change_email SELECTs plan then rewrites it (read-modify-write), while change_plan blind-UPDATEs plan. If change_email reads before change_plan commits and writes after, it overwrites the new plan with the stale plan: lost plan update.

tests.name: lost_plan_update_email_vs_plan
tests.rationale: Old release preserves plan via stale read; new release blind-writes plan. Interleaving SELECT(v1)->UPDATE(v2)->UPDATE(v1) loses v2 plan update while keeping v2 plan_changed_by, corrupting plan vs provenance.

invariants.description: email must be new value in all serial orders
plan must be pro in all serial orders; stale rewrite reverts to free

tests.name: lost_plan_update_two_emails_vs_plan
tests.rationale: Two concurrent old-release email writers both perform stale plan reads; either can overwrite a concurrent new-release plan update. Plan must survive in every serial order, email may be either writer.

invariants.description: plan must remain pro regardless of email order; stale email rewrite loses it
email is last-writer-wins between the two email changes

tests.name: lost_plan_update_email_vs_two_plans
tests.rationale: Email RMW concurrent with two blind plan writes. In any serial schedule final plan is last plan writer (pro or team) and email is new. If email's stale read wins last, plan reverts to free, outside allowed set.

invariants.description: email always updated by v1 writer
plan must be one of the two blind writes; stale rewrite reverts to free
